title: Yoga
coreMove: Strip false difficulty from a body skill so live correction can reach the basic movement.
sourcePressure: The source frames the yoga case through simplification, working with an instructor, clearing misconceptions, and not making the body practice harder than it needs to be.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Confusing simplification with softness, when the chapter uses simplification to expose the real physical rep and make correction possible.

sourceAnchors.name: yoga
sourceAnchors.detail: the frozen support names yoga as the first case application and frames it around simplification, instructor feedback, and clearing misconceptions
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Yoga becomes learnable when the room stops being a costume and the next corrected shape becomes plain enough to feel.

sourceAnchors.name: working with an instructor
sourceAnchors.detail: the source lists working with an instructor as a core move in the yoga chapter
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: A good instructor takes the mystery out of the pose by moving attention to the one joint that is lying.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

skillTargets: identify false difficulty in embodied practice
choose instructor feedback that changes the basic rep
distinguish simplifying from lowering the standard
avoid unsupported health or lifestyle claims

tryThisNowSpec: Pick one physical skill and cross out one difficulty that is mostly costume, then name the one correction you need on the next basic rep.
